generate_gibson_large_dataset: run the script to generate customized Gibson training splits for the PointNav task with quality threshold filtering
generate_pointnav_episodes: create PointNav navigation episodes for a given Habitat simulator scene using generate_pointnav_episode
safe_mkdir: create a directory safely ignoring errors if the directory already exists
filter_gibson_scenes_by_quality: filter Gibson scene datasets by reconstruction quality threshold and train split from statistics JSON
compress_dataset_to_json_gz: compress and save a PointNav dataset as a gzip-compressed JSON file per scene
